brief: The new infra stack for AI startups in 2026 — bye Heroku, hello Cloudflare.

slots.title: 1. Cloudflare, The Edge
slots.body: Host globally on Workers. Cut egress costs and slash cold starts to zero.

slots.title: 2. Supabase, The Database
slots.body: Postgres with auth, storage, and realtime. Run vector queries via pgvector without a second vendor.

slots.title: 3. Vercel, The Frontend
slots.body: Ship Next.js apps with AI SDK streaming. Preview every pull request automatically.

slots.title: 4. Stripe, The Billing
slots.body: Meter usage and charge per token. Stripe handles invoicing, tax, and failed payments.

slots.title: 5. OpenAI, The Brain
slots.body: Call GPT-4o and embeddings via API. No GPU servers, no midnight paging.

slots.title: 6. GitHub, The Pipeline
slots.body: Store code, run Actions, and review PRs. The entire team ships from one place.
